profile.headline: Software Engineer at Workday
profile.summary: Passionate Software Engineer at General Motors, specializing in creating cutting-edge microservices using Java and Spring Boot. I lead the design and development of scalable solutions, implementing event-driven architecture with Kafka for seamless microservices communication. Committed to delivering high-performance and maintainable code. Eager to connect and discuss software architecture, microservices, and the latest tech trends.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Java-based applications and implemented RESTful web services and microservices using Spring Boot to migrate monolith applications to single-purpose microservices to help increase new feature development and rapid deployment.
Designed and developed new features and enhancements to the company's products 
Worked closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality software within tight deadlines.
Developed and maintained unit tests and integration tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Contributed to code reviews and mentored junior developers to improve code quality and development practices.
Also helped with migration of legacy applications hosted on Weblogic to TomEE to reduce the licensing cost for the company.
positions.insights: Kafka Streams, Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Change. Innovate. Sustain. 

Experient Group is a Management and Consulting Services firm where our experience makes the difference.

We work collaboratively with our clients to understand their business and provide the guidance that enables them to achieve value-driven results. Experient's flexible approach means that our services are tailored to the specific needs of our clients and to their critical business objectives.

Our service offerings include strategy and planning, process and operational improvement and systems management & transformation. 

If you are looking for an opportunity to a join a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, where you will have both a challenging and rewarding experience, please give us a call. We are always on the lookout for good, quality additions to our outstanding team of professionals.
